content:
**Roasted Scorchbeast Heart** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

The result of the heart of a Scorchbeast being roasted at a Cooking Station, Roasted Scorchbeast Heart provides a bonus to Endurance alongside restoring a large amount of health.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Scorchbeast Heart | | Roasted Scorchbeast Heart (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station, after having picked up a Scorchbeast Heart for the first time.
